blocks.raw: Hey, we are back with another release. We are always improving the platform and if you have any questions regarding any release, feel free to contact your relations manager or email us directly at [RMteam@drivewealth.com](mailto:rmteam@drivewealth.com).
blocks.text: Hey, we are back with another release. We are always improving the platform and if you have any questions regarding any release, feel free to contact your relations manager or email us directly at RMteam@drivewealth.com.

blocks.raw: We have added support for `remittanceInformation` on funding redemptions. This gives partners additional flexibility when submitting and reviewing redemption details.
blocks.text: We have added support for remittanceInformation on funding redemptions. This gives partners additional flexibility when submitting and reviewing redemption details.

blocks.raw: We have added `accountFundingType` to account creation, account updates, and account retrieval endpoints so partners can better classify account funding behavior.
blocks.text: We have added accountFundingType to account creation, account updates, and account retrieval endpoints so partners can better classify account funding behavior.

blocks.raw: The documents object on user endpoints now accepts a broader set of ID types and metadata fields, enabling account opening for international and non-citizen users.
blocks.text: The documents object on user endpoints now accepts a broader set of ID types and metadata fields, enabling account opening for international and non-citizen users.

blocks.raw: New document types: `PASSPORT`, `ALIEN_ID`, and `OTHER` are now valid values for the type field. `FTNLO` has been removed. New metadata fields: `issueDate`, `expiryDate`, `issuingCountry`, `issuingProvince`, and `description` are now accepted on `POST /users and PATCH /users/{userID}`. Read support: `GET /users/{userID}` now returns `idIssueDate`, `idExpiryDate`, `idIssuingCountry`, and `idIssuingProvince` at the top level of the user object.
blocks.text: New document types: PASSPORT, ALIEN_ID, and OTHER are now valid values for the type field. FTNLO has been removed. New metadata fields: issueDate, expiryDate, issuingCountry, issuingProvince, and description are now accepted on POST /users and PATCH /users/{userID}. Read support: GET /users/{userID} now returns idIssueDate, idExpiryDate, idIssuingCountry, and idIssuingProvince at the top level of the user object.

blocks.raw: We enhanced our entity and account support for trust workflows, including new trust account management types and expanded entity role modeling.
blocks.text: We enhanced our entity and account support for trust workflows, including new trust account management types and expanded entity role modeling.

blocks.raw: We have added a new deposit endpoint to support updates the ACH settlement dates for a deposit by depositID.
blocks.text: We have added a new deposit endpoint to support updates the ACH settlement dates for a deposit by depositID.

blocks.raw: We expanded deposit status handling to support the new `PROCESSING` state across deposit, recurring deposit, and user funding deposit responses. This gives partners more visibility into in-flight deposit activity.
blocks.text: We expanded deposit status handling to support the new PROCESSING state across deposit, recurring deposit, and user funding deposit responses. This gives partners more visibility into in-flight deposit activity.

blocks.raw: We enhanced deposit retrieval responses by adding `seasoningDetails` to deposit details.
blocks.text: We enhanced deposit retrieval responses by adding seasoningDetails to deposit details.

blocks.raw: We added new query parameters to redemption listing so partners can filter and paginate redemption activity more effectively.
blocks.text: We added new query parameters to redemption listing so partners can filter and paginate redemption activity more effectively.

blocks.raw: We corrected and clarified the description for `remittanceInformation` across redemption request and response payloads.
blocks.text: We corrected and clarified the description for remittanceInformation across redemption request and response payloads.

blocks.raw: ## Account funding and overnight trading support
blocks.text: Account funding and overnight trading support

blocks.raw: We improved account configuration support with `accountFundingType`, `overnightHoursEnrolled`, and additional money summary visibility through `cashAvailableForTradeNonMarginable`.
blocks.text: We improved account configuration support with accountFundingType, overnightHoursEnrolled, and additional money summary visibility through cashAvailableForTradeNonMarginable.

blocks.raw: We enhanced instrument responses with `averageLendingRate` for equities and expanded mutual fund metadata support, including new fields and validation updates.
blocks.text: We enhanced instrument responses with averageLendingRate for equities and expanded mutual fund metadata support, including new fields and validation updates.

blocks.raw: We removed the legacy `FTNLO` identification type from supported schemas and improved beneficiary modeling with document support and refined request/response structures.
blocks.text: We removed the legacy FTNLO identification type from supported schemas and improved beneficiary modeling with document support and refined request/response structures.

blocks.raw: We removed unsupported IRA contribution and distribution enum values while also expanding shared enum support for newer retirement use cases.
blocks.text: We removed unsupported IRA contribution and distribution enum values while also expanding shared enum support for newer retirement use cases.

blocks.raw: We are always squashing bugs, but nothing significant during this release that should be called out.
blocks.text: We are always squashing bugs, but nothing significant during this release that should be called out.
